name: Germanic Village
player_description: A palisaded settlement of longhouses around a central fire. Smoke from six hearths. Children stop what they are doing and watch the party arrive. Adults do not stop what they are doing, but they are watching too. The gate is open. No one invited you in.
gm_notes: Session 3. Entering without introduction is an insult — DC 12 History (Roman character) or automatic knowledge (Germanic character) to know this. Correct approach: stop at the gate and wait for acknowledgement. First contact NPC: Edda (spear-mother) or Arnulf (firekeeper) depending on time of day. Edda at dusk, Arnulf at the fire in the evening. Social structure: decisions are collective, not hierarchical. Giving an order will not work. Making a request and waiting for discussion will. The healing-woman's house is separate, slightly outside the palisade to the east. Skadi is there. Thusnelda is an hour's walk at the grove. Do not have the village feel hostile by default — feel assessed. The assessment has a correct answer. It is not impressive martial ability. It is whether the party removes their boots.
